relations.reading: Cross-frame coherence is assessed against an independently specified upstream outcome, making the map–flow argument operational without equating every deviation with value.

relations.title: Pérdida por control sobre mapa divergente
relations.reading: Process conformance identifies a path difference; outcome and counterfactual evidence are still needed to establish whether the deviation preserved the upstream result.

relations.title: Activación de misión
relations.reading: The team is an integrated system when its specialist decisions preserve the same independently stated mission outcome, not merely when every member completes a local deliverable.

relations.title: Activación de misión
relations.reading: Functional trust can support early disclosure of uncertainty when protecting the mission requires giving up a locally favourable account of progress.

relations.title: Cambio de perspectiva humano
relations.reading: The UP move can expose alternatives outside a local frame, while an independently stated upstream outcome is needed to judge whether the new perspective is coherent.

relations.title: Carga de control
relations.reading: The rejected turnstile is a field example of why control value must include its effect on the operating flow, alongside the work and risk it removes.

relations.title: Signo de la desviación
relations.reading: The same network can contain harmful local optimization and useful off-map adaptation; their sign becomes clear only after the upstream outcome and its recipient are specified.

relations.title: Suficiencia para una decisión
relations.reading: Good-enough occupancy is decision-specific: evidence sufficient for coordination must be requalified before it is reused for accounting, enforcement or another commitment.

relations.title: Alcance de bloqueo de una decisión
relations.reading: Reach-weighted latency can operationalize one aspect of informational friction, but the causal loss from a divergent map must still be separated from necessary waiting and other delays.

relations.title: Signo de la desviación
relations.reading: Off-path frequency is a screening measure; load-bearing positive deviation requires evidence that the upstream outcome depended on that path.

relations.title: Fallo de composición
relations.reading: Industrial delivery is complete only when the composed chain supports customer production readiness; passing each local control does not establish that end-to-end outcome.

relations.title: Nivel y frontera del resultado
relations.reading: The territorial dimension makes the frame explicit: an operating outcome must be evaluated against the affected recipients and obligations, not only the contractor's local target.

relations.title: Contribución y reconocimiento
relations.reading: Contribution measurement should separate the reference outcome, the evaluated decision process and the credit assigned, rather than feeding the desired verdict into the measurement.
